primary_population: Al shooting centers with fewer than 7 initial coherent bonds at q6 dot threshold 0.70
primary_target: mean across 8 shooting futures, horizons 12/24/48 ps
future_topology: 16 PCA scores of future persistence images; PCA and score scales fitted only on train targets; equal weight per retained component and horizon
readout: ridge with intercept; per-family, per-horizon alpha selected on validation sources from [0.1,10,1000,100000]; never retrain on validation
encoder_checkpoint: Before physical probes, compare the two retained candidates (legacy best and epoch-60 final) using projected VICReg over the entire 2304-center validation set and the same fixed noise views. This avoids evaluating variance on ordered single-source batches. No physical outcomes enter this selection.
primary_score: 100 * (1 - test MSE / coarse-order-and-temperature baseline test MSE), equal component and horizon weighting
negative_control: SOAP representations independently shuffled within each split, material and temperature; coarse bond order and temperature covariates stay attached to their original environments
architecture_control: Three untrained reference MACE initializations with the same seeds and architecture, frozen and evaluated through the same supervised ridge probes; these distinguish architectural expressivity from VICReg pretraining

neighbor_test.candidates: training inputs at the same temperature, closest in standardized current 8 bond-order measurements
neighbor_test.score: future-target distance of representation-selected neighbors relative to 10 nearest coarse-order neighbors; three continuous target families have equal weight

uncertainty: 1000 paired source-cluster bootstrap resamples of 6 independent test sources; learned model scores average errors across three independent training seeds, not predictions
secondary_event: 48 ps probability that at least 7 bonds are coherent throughout the last three saved frames (0.6 ps); thresholds 0.65,0.70,0.75; clipped ridge; shot-level Brier skill, not classification accuracy
auxiliary_fidelity: per-material current continuous order and persistence images on supplemental held-out snapshots/times; TDA self-reconstruction is explicitly excluded
interpretation: Operational geometric and dynamical assays; no descriptor is ground truth for a new phase. Finite horizons and eight shots do not define a committor.
